name: tldraw release loop
description: One tick of the tldraw desktop release loop: when main has moved, gate it with pnpm check, dispatch the internal TestFlight build, and when something is red let a fixer open and land a PR, re-gate, and try again. A person is pulled in only when the loop stalls. Production promotion is a separate, manual tick.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the checkout, on main

action.description: tick: process new commits on main. promote: promote the current internal build to production

build_workflow.description: Workflow file that builds the internal TestFlight build, for `gh workflow run`. Default: the repo's internal build workflow

requirements.description: repo_path is on main with a clean tree
requirements.check: Run `git -C <repo_path> status --porcelain --branch`; ok if the first line starts with `## main` and nothing else prints

requirements.description: pnpm runs and the repo has a `check` script
requirements.check: Run `pnpm --version` in repo_path and `grep '"check"' package.json`; ok if both print

requirements.description: gh is logged in and can see the repository
requirements.check: Run `gh auth status` and `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner` in repo_path; ok if both succeed

start.title: Which tick is this
start.instructions: Read the action input and fire the matching event. Nothing else.

check.title: Waiting for new commits
check.instructions: `git fetch origin` and `git pull --ff-only`. The last head this loop processed is in `.git/release-loop-last` (a bare SHA; absent on the first run, which means everything is new). Compare it with `origin/main`. Report the new commits with `machine.note`. Do not write the file yet; it is written when a tick ends in released.

new_commit.description: main moved since the last processed head

nothing_new.description: main is where the last tick left it

gate.title: Gate
gate.instructions: On main at head, run `pnpm check`. Green means exit 0. On red, keep the failing output; the fixer needs it. Do not fix anything here.

failure.description: The first failing check and its key lines, when red

dispatch.title: TestFlight build
dispatch.instructions: Dispatch the internal build: `gh workflow run <build_workflow> --ref main`, then find the run (`gh run list --workflow=<build_workflow> --limit=1`) and watch it to the end, posting a note as jobs finish. Released means the workflow succeeded and the build reached internal TestFlight. If a job fails on the code (build or tests), fire build_failed with the failing lines. If the run never starts, hangs, or fails on infrastructure (runner, signing, upload), fire stalled; a fixer cannot help with that. When released, write the head SHA to `.git/release-loop-last`.

released.description: Internal build is on TestFlight; .git/release-loop-last updated

build_failed.description: Build or tests failed on the code

fix.title: Fixer agent
fix.instructions: Branch from main as `huppy/release-fix-<head short SHA>`. Fix only what the gate or build reported, in the smallest change that makes it pass, with a test when one fits. Run `pnpm check` locally until it is green. Push the branch and open a PR with `gh pr create` whose body quotes the failure and says what changed. Do not merge here.

land.title: Land fix
land.instructions: Wait for the PR's checks (`gh pr checks <pr> --watch`). When every check is green and nothing blocks the merge, merge it (`gh pr merge <pr> --squash --delete-branch`), switch back to main and pull. If a check is red, the PR needs a human review, or a reviewer asked for changes, fire needs_review_or_red with the reason. If nothing has moved after a reasonable wait (about 30 minutes), fire timed_out.

merged_sha.description: Short SHA of main after the merge

reason.description: Why the fix did not land, when it did not

merged.description: Main moved; gate the new head

needs_person.title: Needs a person
needs_person.instructions: The loop is paused. Say in a note exactly what a person has to do (merge, review, fix the runner, decide) and where.

clear_attention.description: The person handled it; look at main again

promotion.title: Production promotion
promotion.instructions: Promote the current internal build to production the way the repo does it (its promote script or workflow). Record which build went out.

verify.title: Verify production
verify.instructions: Confirm the production build is live and opens: the store or update feed shows the promoted build, and a fresh install or update launches to the main screen. Record what you checked.
